# Contributing to PinkieSysMon

Thank you for your interest in helping PinkieSysMon. Bug reports, ideas, documentation improvements, and thoughtful code contributions are welcome.

## Report a bug

Before opening an [Issue](https://github.com/Jim1537/PinkieSysMon/issues), check whether the problem has already been reported. Include:

- What happened, what you expected, and steps to reproduce the problem.
- Your Windows version and PinkieSysMon version, if available.
- Relevant error messages, screenshots, or sanitized logs.

Do not post credentials, private configuration, device identifiers, or other sensitive information.

## Suggest an improvement

Open an Issue describing the problem or use case, the desired behavior, and any important constraints. Discuss substantial changes before investing time in an implementation.

## Contribute code or documentation

- Read the [project overview](../docs/README.md) and relevant technical documentation.
- Consult [Building and Deployment](../docs/development/building.md) for the supported build and regression workflow.
- For AI-assisted changes, follow the engineering and verification policy in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
- Respect the [Public Repository Boundary](../docs/PUBLIC-REPOSITORY.md).
- Keep changes focused, explain their purpose, and report which checks you actually ran.
- If you do not have repository write access, submit a focused Pull Request after discussing significant changes in an Issue.

Please also follow our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Contribution proposals are reviewed by the maintainer and may be declined or revised to fit project priorities.

## The most helpful contribution

The best way to support the project is to [buy me a cup of coffee](https://ko-fi.com/Z5X220SWVK). It helps me stay awake while AI does all the other maintenance work. ☕
